register.labelZh: TURN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: TURN 表達可以描述轉身、折返、把某物轉向一旁,以及把某物內外反轉。；turn against 和 turn away from 可以描述人們開始反對、不再信任或停止支持某人或某事物。；你可以 turn down 一項提議、turn away 訪客,或 turn in 已完成的工作。；turn around 可以描述生意或情況好轉;turn into 則可以描述某事物變成另一事物。；turn in on yourself 和 turn somebody’s world inside out 可以描述一個人的感受和日常生活出現重大改變。
register.summaryEn: TURN expressions can describe turning about, turning back, moving something aside or turning something inside out. Turn against and turn away from help you explain when people begin to oppose, distrust or stop supporting somebody or something. You can turn down an offer, turn away visitors or turn in a completed piece of work. Turn around can describe a business or situation improving, while turn into describes one thing becoming something different. Turn in on yourself and turn somebody’s world inside out describe serious changes in a person’s feelings and daily life.
contextsZh: 描述立場和支持的改變
contextsEn: Talk clearly about direction and movement
register.formalZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 TURN 表達。
register.formalEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the TURN expression that gives the same meaning.

fixedVariable.fixedZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 TURN 表達。
fixedVariable.fixedEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the TURN expression that gives the same meaning.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間、結果和意思。；使用 it、him、her 或 them 時,請按照以上例子放在正確位置。；around 和 round 有時可以表達相同意思。Useful Sentence Forms 常用句式The TURN expression can appear in different parts of a sentence. Extra information mayexplain the time, reason or method, but it is not automatically part of the fixed expression.TURN 表達可以出現在句子的不同位置。額外資料可以解釋時間、原因或方法,但不一定是固定表達的一部分。；我們決定折返。；你可能需要把音樂聲量調低。；她的舊朋友開始與她為敵。；經濟正在逐漸好轉。)The new manager has turned the shop round.(新經理已令店舖轉危為安。；數百名球迷被拒絕進場。；你為甚麼拒絕那項提議?)Turn the radio down.(把收音機的聲量調低。；把自己封閉起來並不能解決問題。；拒絕那項提議的決定令我們感到意外。；他竟然反過來責怪我們。；(他們透過更改餐牌,令咖啡店的情況好轉。)The core expression is turn the café around. By changing the menu only explains how theyachieved it.核心表達是 turn the café around。by changing the menu 只是解釋他們如何做到。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time, result and meaning. When using it, him, her or them, follow these examples: turn it down turn him away turn them back turn her in Around and round can sometimes express the same meaning: turn the business around turn the business round After to We decided to turn back. After a modal verb You may need to turn the music down. As an ordinary statement Her old friends turned against her. In an ongoing or completed action The economy is turning around. In a passive sentence Hundreds of fans were turned away. In a question or command Why did you turn the offer down? At the beginning with an -ing form Turning in on yourself will not solve the problem. After a noun The decision to turn down the offer surprised us. With turn around and + action He turned around and blamed us. With an optional method They turned the café around by changing the menu.

benefits.titleEn: Talk clearly about direction and movement
benefits.zh: TURN 表達可以描述轉身、折返、把某物轉向一旁,以及把某物內外反轉。
benefits.en: TURN expressions can describe turning about, turning back, moving something aside or turning something inside out.

benefits.titleZh: 描述立場和支持的改變
benefits.zh: turn against 和 turn away from 可以描述人們開始反對、不再信任或停止支持某人或某事物。
benefits.en: Turn against and turn away from help you explain when people begin to oppose, distrust or stop supporting somebody or something.

benefits.zh: 你可以 turn down 一項提議、turn away 訪客,或 turn in 已完成的工作。
benefits.en: You can turn down an offer, turn away visitors or turn in a completed piece of work.

benefits.zh: turn around 可以描述生意或情況好轉;turn into 則可以描述某事物變成另一事物。
benefits.en: Turn around can describe a business or situation improving, while turn into describes one thing becoming something different.

benefits.zh: turn in on yourself 和 turn somebody’s world inside out 可以描述一個人的感受和日常生活出現重大改變。
benefits.en: Turn in on yourself and turn somebody’s world inside out describe serious changes in a person’s feelings and daily life.

comparisons.titleEn: Talk clearly about direction and movement
comparisons.zh: TURN 表達可以描述轉身、折返、把某物轉向一旁,以及把某物內外反轉。
comparisons.en: TURN expressions can describe turning about, turning back, moving something aside or turning something inside out.

examples.en: He turned around and blamed us.

comparisons.zh: turn around 可以描述生意或情況好轉;turn into 則可以描述某事物變成另一事物。
comparisons.en: Turn around can describe a business or situation improving, while turn into describes one thing becoming something different.

examples.en: The business is finally turning around.
examples.zh: 這盤生意終於開始好轉。

comparisons.zh: turn in on yourself 和 turn somebody’s world inside out 可以描述一個人的感受和日常生活出現重大改變。
comparisons.en: Turn in on yourself and turn somebody’s world inside out describe serious changes in a person’s feelings and daily life.
